claims: A Blue Alert is a rapid notification system used to inform the public and law enforcement when a suspect is wanted for killing, seriously injuring, or posing an imminent, credible threat to a law enforcement officer.
A Blue Alert may also be issued if a law enforcement officer is missing in the line of duty.
Blue Alert information is transmitted via wireless devices (cell phones), the Emergency Alert System (EAS), and media outlets.
Congress established the National Blue Alert Network in 2015.
The National Blue Alert Network supports plans in over 37 states.
Blue Alert criteria generally require the suspect to be considered "armed and dangerous".
Local law enforcement confirms the threat or injury for Blue Alerts.
Blue Alerts function similarly to AMBER Alerts.
Blue Alerts are specific to law enforcement targets.
